---
title: Unminify a file
icon: FileCode
description: Turn one minified or transpiled file back into readable JavaScript.
---

Have a minified script or library you need to understand? Write a readable
copy so you can follow its logic in your editor:

```bash
npx wakaru input.js -o output.js
```

This keeps the code in one file. If you want to split a bundle into modules,
see [Unpack a bundle](/guides/unpack-a-bundle).

## See what changes

Minifiers squeeze conditions and several actions into a single expression:

```js title="input.js"
function submit(e){e.valid&&(track("submit"),send(e.data)),e.pending=!1}
```

Wakaru turns those actions back into separate statements:

```js title="output.js"
function submit(e) {
    if (e.valid) {
        track("submit");
        send(e.data);
    }
    e.pending = false;
}
```

You can now see the two paths: valid input triggers tracking and sending,
while `pending` is cleared either way.

For transpiled code, Wakaru also restores modern syntax such as classes
and `async`/`await` where it recognizes the compiled patterns.
See [What is Wakaru](/what-is-wakaru) for an example.

## Why are some names still short?

The parameter `e` stays `e` in this example. Wakaru improves names when the
code provides enough clues, but most names lost during minification cannot
be recovered from the code alone.

If you have a source map, use it to recover original names. See
[Source maps](/guides/source-maps). Without one, a coding agent can help
choose names from context once the code is readable. Those names are
interpretations, not the original source names.

## If you need to run the result

Start with `minimal` to prioritize preserving the input's behavior:

```bash
npx wakaru input.js --level minimal -o output.js
```

Wakaru aims to produce working code, but cannot guarantee every case. Check
the result in your application. [Rewrite levels](/guides/rewrite-levels)
explains the tradeoffs and shows how the output can differ.

For a quick comparison without writing files, try your code in the
[playground](https://wakarujs.com/playground/).
